crossRefs.note: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;
But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought…

translations.web: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.
translations.bsb: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought—the original owner of the land.
translations.kjv: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land
translations.asv: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.
